skills.name: edk2-pr-workflow
skills.description: Production-grade EDK II PR automation. Two core capabilities: 1) Create PR from Issue, 2) Update PR from review comments. Loads official template, enforces English titles, validates PatchCheck.

skills.name: ovmf-build
